chapter_name: 6.1.1 简单随机样本与样本的联合分布

questions.prompt_html: \text{设 } X_{1},X_{2},\cdots X_{n} \text{ 为来自总体 } X \text{ 的样本，则不成立的是( )}.

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{array}{l}X_{i}(i=1,2,\cdots,n) \text{是确定的数} \end{array}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{array}{l} X _ {i} (i = 1, 2, \dots , n) \text {与} X \text {有相同的分布} \end{array}

options.label: C
options.html: (\,X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\,)\text{是}n\text{维随机变量}

options.label: D
options.html: (\,X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\,)\text{各分量是相互独立且同分布的随机变量}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{样本具有两个性质：}\\&1.\text{代表性：}X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\text{与所考察的总体具有相同的分布；}\\&2.\text{独立性：}X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\text{是相互独立的随机变量.}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设总体} X \text {在区间} [a,b] \text {上服从均匀分布，来自} X \text {的简单随机样本} X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n} \text {的联合概率密度} \\ f(x_{1},x_{2},\cdots,x_{n})=(\quad). \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\dfrac{1}{(b-a)^{n}},\ a\leq x_{1},\cdots,x_{n}\leq b\\0,\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\dfrac{1}{(b-a)^{n}},\ a\leq x_{1},\cdots,x_{n}\leq b\\1,\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\dfrac{1}{(b+a)^n},\ a\leq x_1,\cdots,x_n\leq b\\0,\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\displaystyle \frac{2}{(b-a)^{n}},\ a\leq x_{1},\cdots,x_{n}\leq b\\0,\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \lambda \text{的概率密度为} \ f(x) &= \begin{cases} \dfrac{1}{b-a}, \ x \in [a,\,b] \\ 0, \qquad \text{其它} \end{cases}, \text{由于} X_1, X_2, \cdots, X_n \text{独立且与} \lambda \text{同分布，所以} X_1, X_2, \cdots, X_n \text{的联合概率密度为} \\ f(x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n) &= \prod_{i=1}^n f(x_i) = \begin{cases} \dfrac{1}{(b-a)^a}, \ a \leq x_1, \cdots, x_n \leq b \\ 0, \qquad \qquad \qquad \text{其它} \end{cases}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}x_{i}(i=1,2,\cdots n)\text{是总体}X\text{的一组样本观测值，则}( ).

options.label: A
options.html: \, x _ { i } \, ( i = 1 , 2 , \cdots n ) \text {为} X \text {的} n \text {个取值} \,

options.label: B
options.html: \, x _ { i } \, ( i = 1 , 2 , \cdots n ) \text {的取值是不确定的}

options.label: C
options.html: \, x _ { i } \, ( i = 1 , 2 , \cdots n ) \text {与} X \text {有相同的分布}

options.label: D
options.html: \,x_{i}\,(i=1,2,\cdots n)\text{与}X\text{有相同的数字特征}

questions.analysis_html: \text{样本值是个具体的数值，它是确定的，不存在分布及其数字特征之说}.

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\text{是来自均匀分布总体}U(0,c)\text{的样本，则其联合概率密度为}f(x_{1},x_{2},\cdots,x_{n})=(\text{.}).

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\dfrac{1}{c^n}, & 0<x_1,x_2,\cdots,x_n<c\\0, & \quad\quad\quad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\dfrac{x_1+x_2+\cdots+x_n}{c^n}, & 0<x_1,x_2,\cdots,x_n<c\\0, & \text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\dfrac{1}{c}, & 0 < x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n < c \\ \\0, & \quad\quad\quad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\displaystyle \frac{x_1 x_2 \cdots x_n}{c^n}, & 0 < x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n < c \\0, & \text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{总体}X \text{的概率密度为}f(x)=\begin{cases}\dfrac{1}{c},&0<x<c\\0,&\text{其它}\end{cases},\text{样本}X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\text{的联合概率密度则为}\\f(x_{1},x_{2},\cdots,x_{n})=\prod_{i=1}^{n}f(x_{i})=\begin{cases}\dfrac{1}{c^{n}},&0<x_{1},x_{2},\cdots,x_{n}<c\\0,&\text{其它}\end{cases}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{正态总体是统计应用中最常见的总体. 设总体} X \text{服从} N(\mu, \sigma^{2}), \text{则其样本} X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n} \text{的联合概率分布为} (\text{.}).

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi\,\sigma}}\right)^{n}\exp\biggl\{-\frac{1}{2\sigma^{2}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(x_{i}-\mu)^{2}\biggr\}\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \left( \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 \pi } \, \sigma } \right) ^ { n }

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}\exp \biggl\{-\frac{1}{2\sigma^2}\sum_{i=1}^n(x_i-\mu)^2\biggr\}\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}\right)^{n}\exp\Biggl\{-\frac{1}{2\sigma^{2}}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(x_{i}+\mu)^{2}\Biggr\}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设总体} \lambda \text {服从参数为} p (0 < p < 1) \text {的} 0\text {-} 1 \text {分布，即} P \{X = 1 \} = p, \, P \{X = 0 \} = 1 - p, \text {其样本} X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \cdots , X _ {n} \text {的联合概率分布为( ).} \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}p^{s_n}(1-p)^{n-s_n},\ \text{其中}\ s_n=i_1+i_2+\cdots+i_n,\ \ i_k(1\leq k\leq n)\text{取}1\text{或}0\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}p^{s_n}(1-p)\, ,\,\, \text{其中}\, s_n = i_1 + i_2 + \cdots + i_n\, ,\,\,\, i_k (1\leq k\leq n) \text{取} 1 \text{或} 0\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{array}{l}p^{s_{n}}(1+p)^{s_{1}},\text{其中}s_{n}=i_{1}+i_{2}+\cdots+i_{n},\,\,\,i_{k}(1\leq k\leq n)\text{取}1\text{或}0\end{array}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{array}{l}p(1-p)^{s_{k}},\text{其中}s_{n}=i_{1}+i_{2}+\cdots+i_{n},\ i_{k}(1\leq k\leq n)\text{取}1\text{或}0\end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{样本}X_1,X_2,\cdots,X_n\text{的联合概率分布为} \\ P\{X_1=i_1,X_2=i_2,\cdots,X_n=i_n\}&=p^k(1-p)^{n-s},\\ \text{其中}i_k(1\leq k\leq n)\text{取}1\text{或}0,\ s_n=i_1+i_2+\cdots+i_n\text{是样本观察值中取值为}1\text{的总数}. \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l}A \text{厂生产的某种电器的使用寿命服从指数分布}，\text{参数} \lambda \text{未知}。\text{为此抽查了} n \text{件电器}，\text{则样本的联合密度函数为} \\ f ( x _ { 1 } , x _ { 2 } , \cdots , x _ { n } ) = ( ) . \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\lambda^{n}e^{-\lambda(x_{1}+\cdots+x_{n})},\; x_{1}>0, x_{2}>0, \cdots, x_{n}>0\\0, \qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}n\hat{\lambda}e^{-i(x_1+\cdots+x_n)},\ x_1>0,x_2>0,\cdots,x_n>0\\0,\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}\lambda^{n}e^{-\lambda}(x_{1}+\cdots+x_{n}),\ x_{1}>0,x_{2}>0,\cdots,x_{n}>0\\0,\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}\begin{cases}n\lambda e^{-\lambda}(x_1+\cdots+x_n),\ x_1>0,x_2>0,\cdots,x_n>0\\0,\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{总体是电器的使用寿命，其概率密度为}f(x)&=\begin{cases}\lambda e^{-\lambda x}, & x>0\\0, & x\leq 0\end{cases}(\lambda \text{未知}).\\\text{样本}X_1,X_2,\cdots,X_n \text{是 }n \text{件电器，抽到的 }n \text{件电器的使用寿命是样本的一组观察值.}\\ \text{样本}X_1,X_2,\cdots,X_n \text{的联合概率密度为}&f(x_1,x_2,\cdots,x_n)=\begin{cases}\lambda^x e^{-\lambda (x_1+\cdots+x_n)}, & x_1>0,x_2>0,\cdots,x_n>0\\0, & \text{其它}\end{cases}\end{aligned}
